harness: Node vm shared context; original synchronous test callbacks executed with node:assert/strict; no stubs for assertions or history module

tests.name: pending interpretation survives reload and stays inside its conversation
invalid or oversized interpretation state cannot expand the request body
persists question before response, reload recovers interrupted turn and retry uses same ID
restores full answer, citation identity/offsets, event date, and actual self-check result
new chat archives preceding one, restores selected chat, isolates model context and deletes history
failed requests and technical diagnostic answers do not enter model context as assistant facts
retry of earlier question excludes future turns and cannot duplicate the user turn
context obeys count and total character budget, retains complete adjacent pairs
corrupt storage is not overwritten until user explicitly clears it
quota failure keeps unsaved conversation in memory and older data on disk; save can be retried
another tab creating a chat cannot erase a response to an older in-flight turn
deletion in another tab wins over a late response and does not resurrect private messages
invalid stored citations and credential fields are discarded, user text stays plain data

limitations: Does not replace browser E2E or backend access tests.
